title: EGB Theorem / Claim Graph — Circulation Extension V1.1
authority: mechanically combined convenience patch; additive source patches remain provenance

new_nodes.title: Library–illumination–separator–writeback circulation
new_nodes.summary: The operational Braid is closed only when an illumination produces a typed separator, transport, correction, or facet and writes it back so that later routing and proof search actually change.

new_nodes.title: Jewel response profile
new_nodes.summary: A living artifact exposes what tests act on it, what responses it returns, which distinctions it preserves or collapses, what defeats it, what it composes with, and which dark channels remain.

new_nodes.title: Independent indexes as probes; disagreement as separator
new_nodes.summary: Independent corpus compressions are not averaged into consensus. Their structured disagreement is treated as a probe-generated separator revealing omissions, premature identifications, or different valid entry points.

new_nodes.title: Continuation gain is vector-valued
new_nodes.summary: An artifact is assessed by a non-scalar vector: exact claims installed, corrections propagated, proof paths shortened, frontiers narrowed, source trace improved, modalities connected, and external validation obtained.

new_nodes.title: Demonstrate that circulation changes theorem production
new_nodes.summary: Run controlled fresh-agent tasks and measure whether response profiles, dirty-cone propagation, and separator writeback reduce time-to-frontier, false theorem upgrades, proof/search cost, or source-trace distance.

new_nodes.title: Dynamic sieve phase reconstruction equals maximal separator gap
new_nodes.summary: For the squarefree wheel word, the least horizon reconstructing every CRT phase equals the maximum cyclic largest-gap statistic of the separator sets U_M symmetric-difference (U_M-t).

new_nodes.title: Separator mass does not determine worst-case reconstruction horizon
new_nodes.summary: At M=9,699,690 the one-active-prime p=19 separator has smaller support than the p=17 separator but a shorter maximal indistinguishability horizon.

new_nodes.title: Classify asymptotic dynamic wheel-sieve reconstruction geometry
new_nodes.summary: Determine the order of L*(P(z)), controlling active-prime coordinate, two-slice gap invariant, sparse-task variants, and the joint finite-phase/tail-charge dynamics.
